name: shakti-textiles
description: Shakti Textiles — full-stack B2B website (Express API + React client)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c red,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
